SingeNvcompComputeAndNoVerify.doc: During compression, compute checksums. During decompression, do not attempt to verify checksums.

SingeNvcompComputeAndVerify.doc: During compression, compute checksums. During decompression, verify checksums. A runtime error will be thrown upon configure_decompression if checksums were not included in the compressed buffer.

SingeNvcompComputeAndVerifyIfPresent.doc: During compression, compute checksums. During decompression, verify checksums if they were included.

SingeNvcompExecutionPolicy.doc: Enumeration that defines how an nvCOMP manager trades off kernel latency against concurrency with other work on the device.

SingeNvcompManager.doc: Owns an nvCOMP C++ manager and its CPU/GPU execution settings.

SingeNvcompNative.doc: Each input buffer is chunked according to manager setting and compressed in parallel. Allows computation of checksums. Adds custom header with nvCOMP metadata at the beginning of the compressed data.

SingeNvcompNoComputeAndVerifyIfPresent.doc: During compression, do not compute checksums. During decompression, verify checksums if they were included.

SingeNvcompNoComputeNoVerify.doc: During compression, do not compute checksums. During decompression, do not verify checksums.

SingeNvcompRaw.doc: Compresses input data as is, just using underlying compression algorithm. Does not add header with nvCOMP metadata.

SingeNvcompRead.doc: Streaming input callback taking context, writable bytes, capacity, and an output byte count. Return 0 and set the count to at most capacity on success; a count of zero indicates end of input. A nonzero return reports failure.

SingeNvcompWithUncompressedSize.doc: Similar to RAW, but adds custom header with just uncompressed size at the beginning of the compressed data.

SingeNvcompWrite.doc: Streaming output callback taking context, readable bytes, and byte count. Return 0 after consuming all bytes or nonzero on failure.

nvcompANSCompressionMaxAllowedChunkSize.doc: The maximum supported uncompressed chunk size in bytes for the ANS compressor.

nvcompANSDecompressionMaxAllowedChunkSiz.doc:

nvcompANSRequiredCompressionAlignment.doc:

data_type.doc:
ANS data type to use.

- NVCOMP_TYPE_(U)CHAR: 1-byte, generic data type
- NVCOMP_TYPE_FLOAT16: 2-byte floating-point data type. Applicable to all half-precision data formats.
- NVCOMP_TYPE_FLOAT8_E4M3: 1-byte FP8 (E4M3) floating-point data type.
- NVCOMP_TYPE_FLOAT32: 4-byte IEEE-754 single-precision floating-point data type.

histogram_reduction_log2.doc: Reduces the amount of data used to build the histogram by this log2 factor. 0: exact model (default). N keeps 1/2^N of the slice (1 = 1/2, 2 = 1/4, 3 = 1/8, up to nvcompANSMaxHistogramReductionLog2). Useful to speed up compression when full chunks are known to be sampled from a common distribution. Applies to every data type. Chunks below 4096 ANS symbols are always histogrammed exactly, whatever the requested reduction.

max_sub_chunk_count.doc: Maximum sub chunk count override for compression. 0: default of 8. Nonzero must be a power-of-2 between 4 and 64. Leave zero unless you can tune the performance of your e2e application based on this value.

reserved.doc: These bytes are unused and must be zeroed. This ensures compatibility if additional fields are added in the future.

states_per_lane.doc: Number of interleaved rANS states per lane. 0: auto (default): two interleaved streams for every data type. 1: single stream. 2: two interleaved streams.
